features.name: Real, non-scratch multi-repo ecosystem pilot at the released v1.4.0 tag
features.description: Run the pilot over the operator-designated set of real repositories (the framework hardcodes none; the set is confirmed at H-PHASE-014 or pilot time), each adopted/upgraded to the released immutable tag v1.4.0 under a recorded per-member H-CONSUMER-UPGRADE decision BEFORE its re-bootstrap (NDEBT-018), each worked in its own isolated worktree (never on a member's main branch), then Preflight -> Baseline -> Audit per member and the ecosystem-membership-run aggregate. A real reconciliation plan / release train is built only under recorded H-PLANNING-AUTHORITY / H-TRAIN-ENTRY decisions. Findings are recorded to the members' and the framework's debt registers; evidence is externalised under .agent/evidence/pilot-100/. No scratch-harness fabrication: real repositories and real worktrees only — standing up synthetic members to substitute for real ones is a first-class pilot failure. The NDEBT-034 clone optimization stays deferred (not load-bearing: one bootstrap per member).

features.name: First real simplification review (Repeat stage) over real ecosystem evidence
features.description: Run the ecosystem/06 protocol over the feature-100 pilot evidence plus the accumulated framework surface (protocols/schemas/tools/standards), recording evidence-backed consolidation candidates (duplication, dead weight, over-mechanization) as findings under .agent/audits/<simplification-review-id>/. No consolidation is applied — any actual simplification is proposed as planned work and reserved behind H-CONSOLIDATION (operator-only); the review also records candidate scope for the next planning cycle.

features.name: GA-readiness assessment (no declaration), next-candidate refinement, and phase close
features.description: Assemble the GA-readiness evidence dossier per ecosystem/08 Section 2 preconditions — every benchmark threshold treated strictly as an acceptance requirement carrying a measured, anchored result (never a claim of achieved results); the assessment presents H-GA as OUTSTANDING and declares nothing (GA declaration is the operator's future act alone — the framework never auto-declares GA). Refine and validate the next-candidate scope against the pilot + review evidence; close the phase (canonical phase_014.yaml complete first; manifest second; derived run_state third, per the canonical-first rule).
